zh.title: 每个成功任务的总成本
zh.question: 调用更便宜的路线，算上重试与人审之后还更便宜吗？
zh.assumption: 两条路线各是一个固定大小的任务批次；金额是可编辑的示意值，不是任何真实报价，全部以同一种币种计。人审分钟是整批的总时长，验收数是实测结果，不是预测的模型成功率。
zh.observe: 观察：把人审时间归零，哪条路线更便宜？把人审加回去，结论翻转吗？
zh.footerNote: 示意数据 · 模型假设 · 对应来源
zh.scaleLabel: 两根条共用刻度，满格 = 较高总成本

explanations.a-lower: 按当前成本和验收数计算，路线 A 每个验收任务的总成本更低。
explanations.b-lower: 按当前成本和验收数计算，路线 B 每个验收任务的总成本更低。
explanations.equal: 两条路线每个验收任务持平：差别落在别处（延迟、风险、严重错误）。
explanations.undefined: 至少一条路线没有验收结果：这个比值没有经济意义——不是 0，也不是无穷大。

en.title: Cost per successful task
en.question: Does the cheaper-call route stay cheaper once retries and human review are counted?
en.assumption: Each route is one fixed-size task batch; amounts are editable hypotheticals in a single currency, never real vendor prices. Review minutes are the batch total, and accepted counts are measured results — not predicted model success rates.
en.observe: Observe: set review time to zero — which route is cheaper? Add review back — does the verdict flip?
en.scaleLabel: Both bars share one scale; full width = the larger total cost

explanations.a-lower: At the current costs and accepted counts, route A has the lower total cost per accepted task.
explanations.b-lower: At the current costs and accepted counts, route B has the lower total cost per accepted task.
explanations.equal: The routes tie per accepted task: the difference lives elsewhere (latency, risk, severe errors).
explanations.undefined: At least one route accepted nothing: the ratio is not economically meaningful — not zero, and not infinity.
